Record Class ChaosEffect.VirtualThreadCarrierPinningEffect

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ChaosEffect.VirtualThreadCarrierPinningEffect
Record Components:
pinnedThreadCount - number of carrier threads to hold; must be > 0
pinDuration - how long each pin is held per cycle; must be positive
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChaosEffect
Enclosing interface:
ChaosEffect
public static record ChaosEffect.VirtualThreadCarrierPinningEffect(int pinnedThreadCount, Duration pinDuration) extends Record implements ChaosEffect
Starts pinnedThreadCount virtual threads, each of which holds its carrier for pinDuration per cycle: on JDK 21–23 by sleeping inside a synchronized block (true pinning, no CPU), on JDK 24 and later, where synchronized no longer pins (JEP 491), by spin-waiting (one CPU per held carrier). The held carriers are unavailable to other virtual threads, which queue for a carrier under load. Without allowDestructiveEffects it leaves one carrier free.

Cleanup: all pinning threads are interrupted and the monitor is released when the activation handle is closed.
